caseName: Cafeteria Employees Union, Local 302 v. Angelos
caseNameFull: Cafeteria Employees Union, Local 302 v. Angelos and Cafeteria Employees Union, Local 302 v. Tsakires
attorneys: Mr. Louis B. Boudin for petitioners. Mr. Abraham Michael Katz for respondents.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ *754of certiorari to the Court of Appeals of New York in each case denied on the ground that it does not appear from the record that the federal question presented by the petition was properly presented to or expressly passed on by the New York Court of Appeals.

Mr. Louis B. Boudin for petitioners. Mr. Abraham Michael Katz for respondents. See post, p. 778.
